lines.text: The same as, not same like!
Many learners say: My bag is the same like yours.
Better: My bag is the same as yours.
As! Your phone is the same as mine.

data.wrong: My bag is the same like yours.
data.right: My bag is the same as yours.

quiz.stem: Your phone is the same ___ mine.

native.hook: the same ตามด้วย as!

native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “My bag is the same like yours.” ไหม? 😅 ภาษาไทยพูด “เหมือน” คำเดียว แต่ในภาษาอังกฤษ the same ต้องตามด้วย as ไม่ใช่ like: “My bag is the same as yours.” ฟังครู Carlos แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite

en.tip: Thai uses one word for same, but the same needs as: “the same as yours”
en.caption: Do you say “My bag is the same like yours”? 😅 Thai uses one word for same, but the same needs as, not like. Say “My bag is the same as yours”! Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
